subject.title: Feature: Add maxTurns/maxToolCalls config option to limit agent iterations

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor the linked opt-in model-tool round budget as the first public guardrail, or require total-call and timeout semantics in the same initial contract?
rationale: The open PR implements a coherent but narrower round-counting design, while this issue requests three controls with different accounting, parallelism, and exhaustion consequences.

options.title: Sponsor round budget first
options.body: Refresh the linked PR around verified round semantics, resolve its conflicts, and track total-call and elapsed-time limits as narrower follow-ups.

options.title: Require complete guardrail set
options.body: Pause the implementation until rounds, total calls, parallel batches, elapsed time, precedence, and exhaustion behavior are designed together.

recommendation.title: Sponsor round budget first
recommendation.body: Refresh the linked PR around verified round semantics, resolve its conflicts, and track total-call and elapsed-time limits as narrower follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter authored the prior issue-routing review and has the strongest recent history across both the embedded runner and Codex harness affected by this decision.
